name: La Française de l'Energie S.A.
summary: La Française de l'Energie S.A. engages in the exploration, production, and sell of gas resources in France and Belgium. It also produces green electricity from coal bed methane gas. The company was formerly known as Française de l'Energie SAS and changed its name to La Française de l'Energie S.A. in March 2016. La Française de l'Energie S.A. was founded in 2007 and is based in Forbach, France.
